anyOf.description: Read a value from the source data by static JSONPath. Use $ref for source access, $var for variables, $get for navigating into variables or dynamic paths.

$ref.description: JSONPath from the source root: "$" is the whole source; "$.user.name", "$.items[0].sku" reach into it. Only reads from source data, not variables. For variables use $var, for navigating into variables use $get.

anyOf.description: Return a literal JSON value unchanged.

$const.description: Any JSON value to return as-is.

anyOf.description: Read a scoped variable by name. Variables are created by $with (let bindings), $map/$filter/$reduce/$sortBy (loop element). Returns the whole variable — use $get to navigate into it.

Navigate into a value by path. Use to access fields on variables: {$get: {from: {$var: "item"}, path: ["name"]}}. Also supports dynamic path segments (nodes as segments) and fallback values. Prefer $ref for simple source access.

fallback.description: Fallback value when path is missing.

path.description: Path segments: string keys, numeric indices, or node expressions.

anyOf.description: Bind variables in a scoped block: { $with: { let: { x: ... }, value: ... } }

let.description: Variable bindings: name → expression evaluated in current scope.

value.description: Expression evaluated with the declared variables in scope.

anyOf.description: Map over an array, transforming each element.

as.description: Variable name for the current element.

anyOf.description: Filter an array, keeping elements where condition is truthy.

as.description: Variable name for the current element.

anyOf.description: Reduce an array to a single value using an accumulator.

as.description: Variable name for the current element.

body.description: Expression evaluated for each element with both element and accumulator in scope.

anyOf.description: Slice an array or string by start/end indices.
Flatten a nested array by one level.

$flatten.description: Array of arrays to flatten one level.

anyOf.description: Remove duplicate values from an array (compared by JSON.stringify).
Sort an array by a computed key.

as.description: Variable name for the current element.

by.description: Expression to compute the sort key.

anyOf.description: Add two numbers.
Subtract second number from first.

$sub.description: Two numeric operands to subtract (a - b).

anyOf.description: Multiply two numbers.
Divide first number by second. Throws E_DIVISION_BY_ZERO if divisor is 0.

$div.description: Two numeric operands to divide (a / b). Throws on division by zero.

anyOf.description: The remainder of the first number divided by the second, with the sign of the second: for a positive divisor n it is always from 0 up to n, also for a negative first number. Throws E_DIVISION_BY_ZERO if divisor is 0.

$mod.description: Two numeric operands: the remainder of a divided by b. Throws on division by zero.

anyOf.description: Round a number to N decimal places: to the nearest, or down ("floor") or up ("ceil") with `mode`.

mode.description: Which way to round: "nearest" (the default), "floor" (down, toward negative infinity) or "ceil" (up).

anyOf.description: A number from a number or from numeric text, as data from a form, a CSV or an API often has it. Anything else (other text, true, null, an object) throws E_TYPE unless `fallback` is given.

fallback.description: What to answer when the value is not a number and not such text. Without it that is an error.

value.description: A number, or text that is a number written in digits: "42", "-3.5", " 1e3 ".

anyOf.description: Fill a counted phrase: `{ phrase: "{n} of {total}", slots: { n: 1, total: 12 } }` → "1 of 12".

$fill.description: A pattern value `{ phrase, slots }` — filled with its own slots, source language. Non-patterns pass through.

anyOf.description: Concatenate values into a string with an optional separator.

parts.description: Values to concatenate (coerced to string): a literal list of nodes, or any node that evaluates to an array — a mapped list, a $var.

anyOf.description: Convert a value to its string representation.
Replace {{key}} placeholders in a template with values from an object.
Trim leading and trailing whitespace from a string.
Convert a string to lowercase.
Convert a string to uppercase.
Split a string into an array by separator.
Replace the first occurrence of a substring, or every occurrence with `all: true`.

all.description: true replaces every occurrence. Default: only the first.

anyOf.description: Deep equality comparison (JSON.stringify-based). Returns true or false.

$eq.description: Two values to compare for deep equality.

anyOf.description: Deep inequality comparison. Returns true or false.

$neq.description: Two values to compare for inequality.

anyOf.description: Greater than comparison for numbers or strings.

$gt.description: Two values: returns true if first > second (numbers or strings).

anyOf.description: Greater than or equal comparison.

$gte.description: Two values: returns true if first >= second.

anyOf.description: Less than comparison.

$lt.description: Two values: returns true if first < second.

anyOf.description: Less than or equal comparison.

$lte.description: Two values: returns true if first <= second.

Returns true if string starts with prefix.
Returns true if string ends with suffix.
Returns true if string contains the search substring.
Boolean negation of a truthy/falsy value.

$not.description: Value to negate (truthy → false, falsy → true).

anyOf.description: Short-circuit logical AND.

$and.description: Values to AND. Short-circuits: returns last truthy or first falsy.

anyOf.description: Short-circuit logical OR.

$or.description: Values to OR. Short-circuits: returns first truthy or last falsy.

anyOf.description: Shallow merge multiple objects. Later values overwrite earlier ones.

$merge.description: Objects to shallow-merge (left to right, later wins).

anyOf.description: Return the first non-null, non-undefined value.

$coalesce.description: Values to try in order. Returns first non-null/non-undefined.

anyOf.description: Conditional branching: evaluates branches in order, returns first match or else.

then.description: Value to return if condition is truthy.

key.description: Expression to compute the group key.

Return the values of an object as an array.
Convert [key, value][] entries into an object.

Remove specific keys from an object, keeping the rest.
Returns the type as a string: "string", "number", "boolean", "null", "array", or "object".

$type.description: Value to get the type of.

anyOf.description: Return the length of an array or string.
Format a date value.

format.description: Output format string (dayjs format). Default: ISO 8601.

anyOf.description: Add a duration to a date. Returns ISO string.
Calculate difference between two dates. Returns a number.
Format a date for a human reading in a given locale (Intl.DateTimeFormat).

fallback.description: Rendered when the value is null/undefined/empty. Default: "".

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag ("de-AT", "en-GB"). Required — a default renders plausible nonsense for everybody it is wrong for.

dateStyle.description: Whole-date preset. Mutually exclusive with the field-by-field options below.

hour12.description: Force 12/24-hour. Omit to take the locale's own convention — which is the point of asking for a locale.

timeStyle.description: Whole-time preset. Mutually exclusive with the field-by-field options below.

timeZone.description: IANA zone. Omit and a DATE-only value ("2026-03-14") is read as UTC, which is what stops it rendering as the 13th west of Greenwich.

value.description: ISO string, DATE-only string, or epoch milliseconds.

anyOf.description: Format an amount as money in a given locale (Intl.NumberFormat, style currency).

currency.description: ISO-4217 code — "EUR", "CHF". Required: an amount without one is a number, not money.

digits.description: Fraction digits. Default: the currency's own (2 for EUR, 0 for JPY).

fallback.description: Rendered when the value is null/undefined/empty. Default: "".

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag ("de-AT", "en-GB"). Required — a default renders plausible nonsense for everybody it is wrong for.

minorUnits.description: Value is in the currency's minor unit. Default true. The divisor comes from the CURRENCY, not a hardcoded 100 — JPY has no minor unit and dividing it would be a hundredfold error.

value.description: The amount. Minor units (cents) unless `minorUnits` is false.

anyOf.description: Format a number in a given locale (Intl.NumberFormat).

compact.description: Short form — "1.2K", "1,2 Tsd.". For a headline figure, never for money owed.

digits.description: Maximum fraction digits. Default: the locale's own.

fallback.description: Rendered when the value is null/undefined/empty. Default: "".

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag ("de-AT", "en-GB"). Required — a default renders plausible nonsense for everybody it is wrong for.

minDigits.description: Minimum fraction digits — for a column that should not ragged-edge.

Sugar: average all elements in an array. Desugars to $div($sum, $count).
Sugar: count elements in an array. Desugars to $reduce.
Sugar: find minimum value in an array. Desugars to $reduce + $lt.

anyOf.description: The object with keys renamed IN PLACE — each renamed key keeps its position. If a new name is already a key of the object, that entry is replaced by the renamed one.

from.description: The object whose keys to rename.

map.description: Old key → new key. Keys not listed, and listed keys that are absent, are left alone.

anyOf.description: A copy of `from` with the value at `path` replaced and everything else identical. Missing objects along a string path are created; an index that does not exist is an error.

as.description: The variable name the current value is bound to (default "current").

from.description: The value to copy with one path changed.

path.description: Literal path segments: object keys (strings) and array indexes (numbers).

value.description: The new value at `path`. The value currently there (null when absent) is bound as `$var` `as`.

anyOf.description: Fail with `message` (E_ASSERT) unless `when` is truthy; otherwise evaluate to `value`. How a migration refuses a shape it cannot handle.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person — the whole error text.

anyOf.description: Rewrite every node of a tree — objects, arrays and leaves, at any depth — by rules. Structural: it always terminates, and a replacement is never walked again at its own level.

as.description: The variable each visited node is bound to.

order.description: post (default): a node's children are rewritten first, and its rules see the rewritten children. pre: rules see the node as it was, then the walk descends into whatever they returned.

over.description: The tree to rewrite — any JSON value.

rules.description: Tried in order at every node. No rule matches: the node is kept.

when.description: Evaluated with the node bound to `as`; the first truthy rule wins.
